description: Build a sell for USDC in one call: give token, and percent of the wallet balance (read on chain) or an exact amount. Quotes five routers and returns the best route as a transaction to sign. The Trnch fee is already deducted from the quote; the rate applied is returned as feeBps. Returns { router, feeBps, quote, approval, tx, chainId, from }: approval, when not null, has to be sent before tx, from the same wallet (chainId 99901). Nothing is sent by Trnch. Errors: 503 while the fee recipient is not configured on this chain (nothing is built), 404 no route, 429 rate or build limit (retry-after). Requires an API key (created by wallet signature), sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

amount.description: Exact amount in token units, e.g. 1234.5. Capped at the balance. Use this or percent.

percent.description: Share of the wallet balance to sell, 100 = all. Use this or amount.

slippageBps.description: Max slippage in basis points (100 = 1%). Default 100.

token.description: Token to sell, as an address.

name: trnch_sell
title: Sell a token
